C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the given denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator.
Tag when fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator before subtracting.
Tag for both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items if unlike fractional denominators are reconciled.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed.
Do not tag mere subtraction of numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless it also includes denominator reconciliation.

skills.name: Normalize composite forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as expressing a whole as a whole plus zero fraction or converting a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a chosen denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the rewrite is done to enable later whole-part and fraction-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion between proper fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping from the whole part after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities once they are in compatible form, including subtracting numerators over a common denominator or subtracting fraction parts within mixed-number expressions.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when two fractions with the same denominator are subtracted.
Tag when fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after any needed setup.
Tag when the result may be zero or negative before any borrowing step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag subtraction of whole-number parts alone.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of mixed numbers or rewritten whole-number expressions as a distinct operation from fraction subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when solution steps explicitly subtract whole parts such as 4 − 3 or 3 − 2.
Tag when a mixed number or rewritten whole-plus-fraction form is decomposed and the whole-number components are subtracted.
Tag even if the whole-part result is later adjusted by borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure-fraction items with no whole-number component.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping itself.
Do not tag final combining of whole and fraction parts into one answer.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction and adjust the whole-number part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator and added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as whole plus 0 over a denominator before subtraction starts.
Do not tag simplification after regrouping is complete.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as fraction, mixed number, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced to lowest terms.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0 or a mixed number with zero fractional part is written as an integer.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into the final accepted form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction steps themselves.
Do not tag denominator finding or equivalent-fraction conversion.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting when denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtraction.
Tag for both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items with unlike fractional denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere subtraction of numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless it also includes denominator matching.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number or whole number into a subtraction-ready form, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a whole plus a fractional part with denominator 0/d.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when an improper mixed number like 2 3/2 is rewritten as 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d to align with a fractional or mixed-number subtraction.
Tag when the step explicitly prepares the numbers' forms before subtraction rather than performing the subtraction itself.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary combination of final whole and fractional parts.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping from the whole part to the fraction part.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion unless the step is specifically rewriting the overall number form.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a shared denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution separates a mixed-number subtraction into whole-part subtraction and fraction-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust values after a negative fractional result appears.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction or mixed number.

skills.name: Borrow across mixed number
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to d/d in the fractional part.
Tag when a negative fractional difference is repaired by regrouping across the whole and fraction parts.
Tag for whole-minus-fraction or mixed-minus-mixed cases requiring regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without any regrouping.
Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as x + 0/d unless a later step actually borrows.
Do not tag simplification after regrouping is complete.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms or rewrite a zero fractional part as a whole number or integer result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction such as 2/10 is reduced to 1/5.
Tag when 0/3 is rewritten as 0 or when 1 0/3 is rewritten as 1.
Tag when the final result is explicitly simplified from a non-lowest-term fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward reporting of an already simplified result.
Do not tag the act of combining whole and fraction parts unless simplification also occurs.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion or subtraction itself.

skills.name: Compose final result
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number part and fractional part into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into a mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when the solution explicitly states a combine step after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that produce the parts but do not recombine them.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also combines parts into final form.
Do not tag normalization steps done before subtraction.

A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting when denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtraction.
Tag for unlike fractional parts inside mixed-number subtraction as well as pure-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 fractional part unless a denominator is being matched for fraction subtraction without equivalent-fraction conversion.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless it also includes creating equivalent fractions with a common denominator.

skills.name: Normalize number form
skills.definition: Rewrite a quantity into a subtraction-ready form, such as converting a mixed number with an improper fraction part to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2 is normalized to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5.
Tag when the rewrite is done to align whole and fractional parts for later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary equivalent-fraction conversion used only to create a common denominator.
Do not tag the final combining of whole and fraction parts into a mixed number.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping from the whole part into the fraction part.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution separates a mixed-number subtraction into whole-part subtraction and fraction-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting to equivalent fractions before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after a negative fractional result appears.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction or conversion of 0 over n to 0.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator fractional units, such as 12/12 or 5/5.
Tag when borrowing resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction.
Do not tag simplification after the regrouped subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms or to an integer when the fractional part is reducible or equals zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when a zero fraction is simplified to 0 or removed from a mixed number.
Tag when the final result is expressed in lowest terms after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction step that produces the unsimplified result.
Do not tag combining whole and fraction parts if no reduction or zero simplification occurs.
Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion done before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole and fractional parts and express the answer in an appropriate final form such as a mixed number, fraction, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into a mixed number.
Tag when a result with whole part 0 is expressed as just a fraction.
Tag when the final answer is written as an integer after combining parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag simplification itself unless the step is specifically about recombining parts into the final representation.
Do not tag preliminary rewrites such as 3 = 3 + 0/5.
Do not tag subtraction or borrowing steps before the final expression is formed.
